design: Exploratory retrospective comparison motivated by earlier results; previously exposed participants. No untouched, external validation, causal or noninferiority claim.
objective: Measure the standalone predictive performance of all18 optional features and the added contribution of baseline MoCA and the remaining core, compared with frozen core-plus18 full-model predictions.

population.landmark: Existing RNA collection month-end; baseline assessments in previous three calendar months. Original RNA-selected population is retained for matched comparison, although RNA is not a predictor. Monthly precision cannot establish order within a month.
population.outcome: Existing education-adjusted continuous MoCA, exact locked source-row binding. No MCI/dementia label.
population.prior_use: Prior discovery, earlier models and temporal evaluation remain acknowledged; nested CV does not undo exposure.

exclusion_rule: Exclude named raw predictors, all their missingness indicators and categorical encodings. No residualization, core-derived predictions, interactions, RNA, UPSIT or new feature selection.

preprocessing.numeric: Training median imputation, all-missing training column ->0. Training mean and population-SD scaling of imputed values; SD<=1e-12 ->1. Fixed missing indicator for every numeric column, unscaled.
preprocessing.categorical: Fixed complete one-hot dictionaries, no dropped level; blank/invalid raw values become unknown during binding. No outcome-derived vocabulary.
preprocessing.intercept: Unpenalized; all design columns centred within solver training rows.

missingness: Identical participant rows for every mask and arm. Source-invalid optional values become missing. Median and scaling learned within each inner-training fold and outer refit; numeric missingness indicators attached. All-missing training column is zero/inactive with missingness indicator. No complete-case mask-specific cohorts.

model.objective: mean squared training error + lambda*sum(coefficients squared); intercept unpenalized
model.penalty_tie: Minimum pooled inner MSE; within absolute 1e-12 MoCA-points-squared choose largest lambda.
model.prediction: Unclipped for primary and tuning; no interaction or nonlinear expansion

tuning: Each fixed new arm independently minimizes total inner SSE / total inner validation n across the same3folds. Largest lambda within absolute1e-12 of minimum. No one-SE burden rule, GA, or global penalty choice.

splits.source: Existing known-identity grouped master allocation from model_readiness_2026-10-24. Unchanged subsets across horizons.
splits.selection_outcomes: Only inner-validation outcomes from outer-training people may influence masks, penalties, seed pooling or final model. Outer-test outcomes inaccessible to search API.

reference.source_recipe: Frozen MSE-tuned core-plus18, separately tuned in each outer training cohort
reference.require: Exact PATNO, identity component, outcome, fold and recorded full-model prediction binding; reject shuffled positional assumptions.

metrics.primary: 36-month pooled outer delta R2: optional18_only minus frozen full; positive favours optional18_only.
secondary: All9 fixed arm/horizon contrasts in R2 and MAE
metrics.R2: 1-SSE/SST using the pooled observed outcomes; never average fold R2; retain negative values.
metrics.clipping: No clipping in tuning or primary metrics; fixed0–30 clipping descriptive only.

inference.unit: known identity component; exactly one person per component in these fixed cohorts
inference.interval: Paired percentile2.5/97.5 intervals conditional on fixed OOF predictions. Resample aligned participants; recompute SST. R2-undefined constant-outcome draws counted/omitted without replacement; require4750/5000 valid for R2 interval.
inference.primary_status: Single designated exploratory contrast; original studies retain their primary claims.
inference.secondary_status: All remaining contrasts unadjusted/descriptive; no selectively reported horizon.
inference.limitation: No full development-process uncertainty, multiplicity-controlled confirmation, equivalence or noninferiority claim.

burden.optional18_plus_moca_addition: One baseline MoCA assessment beyond the18 panel
burden.comparison: List required information/assessments for each arm; old core_cost=0 is not an estimate of total workflow burden. No burden optimization or time/cost claim.

allowed_now: Synthetic numerical, exclusion, results and guard validation
execution.future_run_requires: New explicit user training authorization bound to this PLAN_LOCK and LAUNCHER_LOCK; fresh direct sibling output folder under Clinical_hallmark.
execution.backend: CPU float64; small fixed480-fit workload, no GPU or GA search
execution.failure: Abort on binding/numerical/identity failures. Fresh output only; failed runs retain failure record and cannot be overwritten. No automatic resumption.
